findings.body: The test claims to check the active link after a reset, but its circle mock never updates and the assertion expects the pre-reset URL. The integration test also checks WhatsApp text only before resetting. Add a post-reset share assertion against the new URL so the test fails if sharing a stale link.
findings.title: Not done: post-reset WhatsApp share uses the active link

findings.body: The reset integration test checks invite-code rows directly, but never opens the old and new links through the invite endpoint. That leaves the required user-facing result unproven. The supplied OpenAPI change still describes the join endpoint as returning 501, so this flow check depends on the later join task.
findings.title: Later: join task should test reset links through the public invite flow
